title: NASA-UAP-D015, Astronaut Scientific Debriefings, 1962-1963
doc_notes: This document contains scientific debriefings of astronauts John Glenn and Gordon Cooper regarding visual observations during Mercury missions, including reports of luminous particles and unidentified lights. / This document is a transcript of a scientific debriefing of astronaut Walter Schirra regarding his 1962 orbital flight, containing reports of anomalous visual phenomena.

encounters.summary: Astronaut John Glenn reported luminous particles traveling with the Friendship-7 spacecraft during sunrise, which were later identified as particles emanating from the capsule.
encounters.entity_appearance: luminous particles, yellow-green, fluorescent in sunlight
encounters.entity_behavior: traveling with spacecraft, moving away from thruster firings
encounters.quote: thousands of luminous particles apparently travelling with the spacecraft

encounters.summary: Astronaut Gordon Cooper reported seeing a flashing light in space during night orbits, which he initially could not identify but later attributed to sunlight reflecting off the retro pack.
encounters.entity_appearance: solid light, flashing, second magnitude star brightness
encounters.entity_behavior: moving relative to spacecraft, flashing at regular intervals
encounters.quote: It was solid light. My first thought on it was that it looked just like the missiles that I have seen launched at night

encounters.summary: Astronaut Schirra observed a brownish, smog-like layer across his entire visible horizon while drifting over the Indian Ocean, which he initially misidentified as airglow.
encounters.entity_appearance: brownish, smog-like, fog effect, diffuse layer
encounters.quote: It was definitely toward the brown smog thing.
